text:
ella: FYI — 09:15 PT outage alert for embeddings in us-west. Pause the launch thread and all benchmark tweets targeted to NA for now.

status-bot: [alert] embeddings_latency_spike detected at 09:15 PT.

jon: Ops investigating. Early signal points to a memory leak on cache nodes after a recent config change. Rolling restart in progress. ETA ~25m.

mike: For status page copy I suggest short public language and clear next-update ETA. Draft:```Status: Investigating
Summary: We're investigating increased latency for embeddings in US-West affecting a subset of requests. Engineers are working on mitigation.
Next update: ~30 minutes.
Impact: Increased latency and potential retries for some customers.```

ella: Good. Also hold the webinar reminder email for NA. If we get green in <30m we may proceed, otherwise reschedule by 24h.

jon: Restart done 09:32 PT; initial metrics looking better. Running a 15m validation window.

mike: Recommend keeping status at "Monitoring" until validation window passes, then mark "Resolved" and post a short follow-up explaining root cause as memory leak and restart mitigation.

ella: Published initial Investigating at 09:18 PT. Monitoring at 09:33 PT. Will publish Resolved after 15m stable.

jon: Validation passed at 09:48 PT. No regressions in last 10m.

mike: Final resolution copy:```Status: Resolved
Summary: We resolved elevated embeddings latency in US-West caused by a memory leak on cache nodes. Engineers performed rolling restarts; service is back to normal.
Timeline: Issue began ~09:15 PT, mitigated 09:32 PT, validated 09:48 PT.
Follow-up: We'll harden monitoring and fix the leak to prevent recurrence.```

ella: Approved. Published resolution at 09:49 PT and reopened the NA webinar send for +1h. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
